capability: Deterministic reference-implementation known-answer-test (KAT) audit runtime. evaluate_known_answers loads the compile-time-embedded control_by_control_receipt.v1.json (14 hand-audited coating-industry industrial standards controls: 6 ARITH-* volume-solids/density controls verified against manufacturer TDS values, 2 MIL-F-160 component-density controls verified against MIL-DTL-24441 tolerances, and 6 categorical PASS/HOLD controls from the F160/F161 formulary), independently recomputes verified_pass/verified_fail/unverified sub-counts by walking the controls array, validates that every control row carries a valid SHA-256 source_artifact_sha256, and honestly reports status='FAILED_GATES' with audit_pass_rate=13/14 because 1 historical control (F160-BLACK) remains UNVERIFIED awaiting authoritative /38B or NAVSEA/DLA source. Never re-labels the 6/6 arithmetic subset as a 14/14 audit. Grants no batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, regulatory, safety, procurement, or candidate-performance authority.
population: Fourteen hand-audited control points from the coating-industry industrial-standards corpus: 4 ARITH-A221-X70P1 and ARITH-A702B75P1 volume-solids/density controls; 2 ARITH-MIL-F160 component-A/B density controls; 6 categorical PASS/HOLD controls from the F160/F161 formulary (F160-BLACK, F161-YELLOW, F161-CG-8010-STD, F161-INSIGNIA-RED, F161-INSIGNIA-BLUE, F161-INSIGNIA-WHITE); 2 additional controls anchored to /38B and MIL-DTL-24441 references. The KPI harness invokes the runtime with 5 independent formulation candidates to verify byte-stability across replays and per-candidate determinism. Three fail-closed probes cover wrong candidate_type, unknown module_id, and whitespace module_id inputs.
split_methodology: No fitting - known-answer audit is closed-form receipt parsing + count aggregation + gate arithmetic. The harness independently recomputes verified_pass_count (13), verified_fail_count (0), and unverified_count (1) by walking the controls array and asserts bit-exact equality with the receipt's stored sub-counts. Each control is verified to carry a valid 64-hex SHA-256 source_artifact_sha256. The arithmetic 6/6 subset is enumerated by counting control_ids starting with 'ARITH-'. Any drift of embedded receipt bytes changes the recomputed counts, breaks receipt vs. observed equality, and forces gate failure. Byte-stability across replays is confirmed by comparing serialized ModuleResult payloads across five independent AssuranceCapability::evaluate invocations.
theory: FIPS 140-3 (2019) Section 7.4 'Cryptographic Module Self-Tests' - Known-Answer Test (KAT) methodology as the standard-of-record for validating that a reference implementation reproduces documented expected outputs. NIST SP 800-140F (2020) 'CMVP Approved Non-Invasive Attack Mitigation Test Metrics' - test-vector construction and residual-uncertainty reporting. NIST FIPS 180-4 (2015) 'Secure Hash Standard' - SHA-256 source-artifact hash binding methodology. IEEE 730-2014 'Standard for Software Quality Assurance Processes' - control-by-control audit review and formal test-plan documentation. IEEE 1149.1-2013 'Standard Test Access Port and Boundary-Scan Architecture' - reference-implementation boundary-scan self-test as an industrial-hardware analog to software KAT. Boehm 1988 'A Spiral Model of Software Development and Enhancement' Computer 21(5):61-72 - honest incomplete-audit reporting as a quality practice. Deming 1986 'Out of the Crisis' MIT CAES - the discipline of never re-labeling a partial audit as complete. Explicit missing_inputs reporting is standard practice under both FDA 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records + ICH Q9(R1) 2023 Quality Risk Management for pharma-adjacent audit trails.

metrics.name: receipt_schema_and_structure_correctness_rate
metrics.note: Receipt schema == 'amphora.known-answer-control-receipt.v1', control_count matches controls array length, sub-counts (verified_pass/verified_fail/unverified) equal harness-side recomputation from the status field, control_id set has no duplicates, and every row carries a valid 64-hex SHA-256 source_artifact_sha256.

metrics.name: pinned_control_count_14_rate
metrics.note: Total control count is 14 exactly (populate-time pin against the checked-in receipt).

metrics.name: pinned_verified_fail_count_0_rate
metrics.note: VERIFIED_FAIL count is 0 exactly. Any silent regression that flips a control to VERIFIED_FAIL trips this gate.

metrics.name: pinned_unverified_historical_count_1_rate
metrics.note: UNVERIFIED historical count is 1 (F160-BLACK, awaiting authoritative /38B or NAVSEA/DLA source). The KPI pins this so any drift is caught.

metrics.name: arithmetic_subset_6_of_6_pass_rate
metrics.note: Exactly 6 controls have control_id starting with 'ARITH-' and all 6 are VERIFIED_PASS. The arithmetic subset is preserved at 6/6; the whole audit remains 13/14.

metrics.name: runtime_status_honestly_failed_gates_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, runtime returns ModuleResult.status = 'FAILED_GATES' - the honest reporting of a 13/14 audit. A runtime that returned 'SCORED' with a 13/14 rate would be misleading; a runtime that returned 'FAILED_GATES' correctly signals to downstream consumers that the audit is incomplete.

metrics.name: runtime_score_matches_13_over_14_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, score_0_1 = 13.0/14.0 within f64 tolerance (independent recompute).

metrics.name: runtime_gates_correctly_report_incomplete_audit_rate
metrics.note: For each of 5 candidates: control_receipt_well_formed=true, all_14_controls_verified=false (because 1 UNVERIFIED), known_answer_audit_passed=false (because 13/14 not 14/14). All three gates honest for all 5 candidates = 15/15.

metrics.name: runtime_metrics_pin_counts_and_arithmetic_subset_rate
metrics.note: For each of 5 candidates: metrics.control_count=14, verified_pass_count=13, verified_fail_count=0, unverified_count=1; arithmetic_subset_checks=6, arithmetic_subset_pass=6. All bit-exact for all 5 candidates = 10/10 aggregate metric assertions.

metrics.name: explicit_missing_input_communicates_gap_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, missing_inputs contains the 'UNVERIFIED' historical-control call-out so a downstream reader sees the runtime is not pretending the audit is 14/14 and knows exactly which control needs re-verification.

metrics.name: authority_ceiling_preservation_rate
metrics.note: For each of 5 candidates: ranking_quarantine=true, scientific_applicability='UNVALIDATED', and no serialized key matches batch_release / release_authorized / qualified / authorized_by / manufacturing_qualification / release_authority. Ten samples, all locked.

metrics.name: unsupported_input_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: Three probes: (a) candidate_type='evidence_package' rejected via CapabilityError::CandidateType (module accepts only 'formulation'); (b) unknown module_id 'amphora-does-not-exist' rejected by AssuranceCapability::new; (c) whitespace module_id '   ' rejected. All three fail closed.

metrics.name: byte_stable_two_replay_rate
metrics.note: Observational. AssuranceCapability::evaluate invoked twice per candidate with identical inputs produces byte-identical ModuleResult (5/5).

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.prediction_rule: For each formulation candidate: (1) load embedded control_by_control_receipt.v1.json via parse_json_strict; (2) verify receipt.schema == 'amphora.known-answer-control-receipt.v1'; (3) enumerate controls array (must be exactly 14); (4) count status='VERIFIED_PASS' (13), 'VERIFIED_FAIL' (0), 'UNVERIFIED' (1); (5) assert receipt's stored counts equal harness recomputation; (6) verify unique control_id set of length 14; (7) verify every control has a valid 64-hex SHA-256 source_artifact_sha256; (8) count ARITH-* controls (6, all VERIFIED_PASS); (9) return ModuleResult with status='FAILED_GATES', score_0_1=13/14, gates.control_receipt_well_formed=true, gates.all_14_controls_verified=false, gates.known_answer_audit_passed=false, metrics.arithmetic_subset_pass=6; (10) explicit missing_inputs entry that names the UNVERIFIED historical gap; (11) explanation that the 6/6 arithmetic subset is not represented as 14/14.
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.note: Reference-implementation KAT audit. No parameters to learn; the theory is FIPS 140-3 Section 7.4 KAT + NIST SP 800-140F test-vector methodology + IEEE 730 SQA discipline of never re-labeling a partial audit as complete.

dataset_fixture_note: SHA-256 of amphora-known-answer-benchmarks/reference/mvp20/out/control_by_control_receipt.v1.json - the on-disk 14-control receipt embedded at compile time by evaluate_known_answers. Any receipt drift changes this hash and the KPI recompute detects it.
